Fact.Name: Forms 1099-LS
Fact.Description: Forms 1099-LS received for the 2025 return, one item per acquirer notice.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS calendar year
Fact.Description: The calendar year shown in the header of this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS void
Fact.Description: The VOID box of Copy A, the acquirer's copy filed with the IRS. The payment recipient's Copy B has no VOID box (its header prints only CORRECTED (if checked)), so a recipient leaves this unanswered. Read by nothing: a notice is reviewed whether or not this box is answered, and no answer here removes a reportable policy sale from the return.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS corrected
Fact.Description: Whether the acquirer marked this Form 1099-LS CORRECTED.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS acquirer name address and telephone number
Fact.Description: The acquirer's name, mailing address, and telephone number from this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS acquirer TIN
Fact.Description: The acquirer's taxpayer identification number (TIN) from this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS payment recipient TIN
Fact.Description: The payment recipient's taxpayer identification number (TIN) from this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS payment recipient name
Fact.Description: The payment recipient's name from this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS street address
Fact.Description: The payment recipient's street address from this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS city or town state or province country and zip or foreign postal code
Fact.Description: The payment recipient's city, state or province, country, and postal code from this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS policy number
Fact.Description: The life insurance policy number in the reportable sale on this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS amount paid to payment recipient
Fact.Description: Box 1 amount paid to the payment recipient in the reportable policy sale on this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS date of sale
Fact.Description: Box 2 date of the reportable policy sale on this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS issuer name
Fact.Description: The name of the life insurance contract issuer on this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS acquirer information contact name address and telephone number
Fact.Description: The acquirer's information contact name, address, and telephone number from this Form 1099-LS.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-LS tax treatment unavailable
Fact.Description: A Form 1099-LS is present whose policy-transfer tax treatment cannot yet be determined for the 2025 return. Every entered notice counts: the recipient copy has no VOID box, so no answer removes a notice from this review.
